title: specs/ canon corpus (blackbox-spec), third sibling of design/research
content: `specs/` is the canon corpus (`corpus: blackbox-spec`): normative, source-grounded contracts for what each subsystem should be/do — the third sibling of `design/` (intent) and `research/` (description). Status lifecycle `draft → specified → ratified`; per-clause source-tier grading (`standard`/`vendor`/`research`/`derived`), no RFC-2119 keywords; backfilled by inverting code + design + research; the conformance section wires clauses to code/intent/evidence anchors. Charter: `specs/specs-corpus.md`.
